Hi all — adding operational detail for the CSV I shared: 

- Column notes included in the file: trigger_date, trigger_type (monthly/milestone), amount_usd, fallback_policy, GL_code, invoice_template.
- Fallback policy: if milestone not met by +5 business days we hold the top-up and issue a reconciliation invoice the following month. If immediate access is required, we can create a temporary credit with authorization from procurement.
- For the ledger handoff, please confirm the exact bank account name and remittance reference you prefer.

Attachment: quick stub of the ledger format.

Cheers,
Ben
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Price <sarah.price@falken.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T08:55:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: VAT evidence & country-specific asks

Sarah — quick VAT checklist from our side so we can mark invoices as VAT-compliant on issue: 

- EU: VAT certificate (company-level) + registered VAT number + billing address on PO.
- UK: VAT registration copy + VAT reverse-charge confirmation if applicable.
- US: state sales-tax exemption certificate if Falken is claiming exemption.
- If you use a shared procurement email for remittance, please confirm exact remit-to email/text for automated receipts.

Please attach certificates to the Drive folder or reply-all with PDFs. Once we have the certificates we will flag the invoice templates and run the first sweep on the agreed cut date.

Also noting: for bookkeeping we prefer a single consolidated invoice per sweep with line items for the monthly consumption and any milestone top-ups — let me know if that causes issues on your end.

Thanks,
Monica
Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-vat-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF)]
